_comment: Fixture: 1 candidate with a locked-field conflict assumption — exercises Step 7b re-clarification gate category (iii). The candidate's assumption contradicts the locked Desired Solution field. eval.py validates schema normally; the skill's Step 7b logic surfaces the conflict to the user.
desired_outcome: A hiring manager can see a ranked list of candidates for a role, where each candidate is scored against the role's required competencies, without leaving the existing HR portal.

candidates.design_context_override: explore a synchronous step-by-step design with no background agents

b1_output.agreed_solution_description: A new scoring module embedded in the HR portal evaluates each candidate's CV against a competency matrix defined by the hiring manager. Scoring is done by Claude on-demand when the hiring manager opens a role's candidate list. Scores are cached per candidate per role for 7 days. The hiring manager sees a sorted table with score, top-3 matched competencies, and a quote from the CV grounding each match.

architecture_decisions.choice: On-demand synchronous scoring when the page is opened
architecture_decisions.rationale: Avoids background job complexity. The hiring manager waits 10-30 seconds on first view; subsequent views use the 7-day cache.
architecture_decisions.discovery_anchor: without leaving the existing HR portal

architecture_decisions.choice: Hiring manager defines competencies via a form in the HR portal; stored as JSON in the portal DB
architecture_decisions.rationale: Keeps all configuration inside the portal. No external spreadsheet imports needed.
architecture_decisions.discovery_anchor: scored against the role's required competencies

architecture_decisions.choice: Anthropic Claude API via a dedicated service account
architecture_decisions.rationale: Assumes the organization is permitted to send CV data to an external AI vendor. This is a key assumption that must be confirmed with legal/compliance.
architecture_decisions.discovery_anchor: ranked list of candidates for a role

ux_decisions.choice: Ranked table embedded in the existing role view
ux_decisions.rationale: Hiring manager stays inside the HR portal. No new window or tool.
ux_decisions.discovery_anchor: without leaving the existing HR portal

abstraction_test.reasoning: Components: CompetencyMatrix, ScoringService, ScoreCache, CandidateRankingView. Names are role-clear.

responsibility_alignment_test.reasoning: ScoringService scores only. ScoreCache caches only. CandidateRankingView displays only. No cross-cutting.

evolution_test.notes: If AI vendor changes, only ScoringService changes. If cache TTL policy changes, only ScoreCache changes.

communications_patterns_test.notes: Portal → ScoringService → Claude API → ScoreCache → CandidateRankingView. One-way chain.

data_connectedness_test.notes: ScoringService receives CV text and competency matrix. Has all it needs.

data_variations_test.notes: No competencies defined → scoring disabled with guidance to define them first. Cache miss on first view → synchronous wait with spinner. External API timeout → cached fallback or error with retry option.

assumptions: The organization is permitted by legal/compliance to send CV data to an external AI vendor (Anthropic). THIS IS A LOCKED-FIELD CONFLICT: the Desired Solution field specifies 'on-premise AI only' — this candidate assumes external vendor, which directly contradicts the locked constraint.
The 7-day cache TTL is acceptable for scoring freshness

scored against the role's required competencies
on-premise AI only — no CV data leaves the organization network
